entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `maui/inflight/current` can't be mirrored to Azdo fast forward branch #32842
  • SourceGen: values are not passed properly to Converters #32837
  • SourceGen: Error CS0030 string to Color #32836
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • MediaPicker.PickVideosAsync returns only file names as file path and doesn't compress the videos anymore under iOS #32832
  • XamlC cannot resolve types from external libraries with HTTP-based xmlns in class libraries #32830
  • SourceGen does not work #32829
  • Make MauiDoneAccessoryView DoneButton accessible #32825
  • Rapid change of selected tab results in crash on Windows. #32824
    Backlog

Closed

  • Setting UIDesignRequiresCompatibility does not opt out Liquid Glass (iOS) #32814
  • CollectionView iOS weird scrolling behavior #32809
  • [.NET 10] Xaml Source Gen - MAUIX2003 error using CardView.MAUI #32764
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • One frame flyout bug on a tab bar menu #23483

    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Ambiguous type 'Font' in xmlns 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui' #32751
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • BindableProperty validation does not throw an ArgumentException, although it is documented as such #25823
    Backlog
  • Disable picker options? #32826

    .NET 10.0 SR2

    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Visual Studio 2026 with .NET 9: no iOS emulator or device showing up #32645
  • Top menu gets shifted upward on Android 9.0 (API 28) device #32813
  • Release mode for a NET9 MAUI failed to find entry classes.dex #32652
  • CollectionView content clipped when keyboard is open on Android #32257
  • .net MAUI 9 Shell.PresentationMode = NotAnimated does not work on Android 15 #32258
